citations.quote: today signed SB 14 (Grove) into law to steepen penalties for human trafficking of minors in California.
Sen. Shannon Grove (R-Bakersfield) announced her bill, Senate Bill 14, was signed into law by Governor Newsom today.

title.value: Human trafficking of minors: serious felony

citations.quote: Governor Newsom signed SB 14 (Grove) to make the trafficking of a minor for purposes of a commercial sex act a serious felony.
